dedupe_keys.name: orbital ownership data satellite operator year panel tracking orbital use patterns

description: The orbital ownership repository contains a satellite-operator-year panel that tracks who owns which active payloads in which orbits over time, with concentration measures of orbit use. It is built by Akhil Rao at Middlebury College, with contributions from Gordon Lewis and Ethan Berner, because object catalogues record where things were sent but lack the ownership fields needed for economic analysis of orbit use. The panel combines and cleans the Union of Concerned Scientists satellite database (including historical copies) with Space-Track.org records, and adds Jonathan McDowell's launch log and satellite catalogue. Coverage is global, active payloads only; debris, launch prices and location-specific payoffs are planned. Format and access: Excel, CSV and JSON files plus R cleaning scripts in a public repository; a frozen version is in the Middlebury replication files of the paper on oligopoly competition between constellations. Licence: the repository has no licence file, although all inputs are public-domain sources; the frozen Middlebury replication files are CC-BY-4.0 (read on 2026-09-29); free. Caveats: owner harmonisation is manual and effort-intensive, and the data flow may switch to the JSR catalogue. It supports capacity planning and economic studies of congestion in low Earth orbit. Related catalogue records are the UCS Satellite Database and GCAT, which it draws on.
